tenderSchedule.title: RFP FOR PROCUREMENT OF SECURE SOCKETS LAYER (SSL/TLS) MANAGEMENT AND CERTIFICATE FOR KSDC WITH 3 YEARS SUPPORT.
tenderSchedule.description: RFP FOR PROCUREMENT OF SECURE SOCKETS LAYER (SSL/TLS) MANAGEMENT AND CERTIFICATE FOR KSDC WITH 3 YEARS SUPPORT.

tenderAddress.blockNumber: Room no 253, 2nd gate, 2nd floor, M S building

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder must be a company registered in India under companies Act/Limited Liability partnership act and should have been in operation for a period of at least 5 years as on bid date. (Consortium and joint ventures formed for the purpose of this project are not eligible to bid for this project. Trusts and societies are also not eligible to bid for this project)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Certificate of Incorporation / Certificate of Partnership

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should not have been blacklisted by the Government of India or any state government or any of its agencies for any reasons whatsoever and the bidder should not have been blacklisted by Central / any other State/UT Government or its agencies for indulging in corrupt or fraudulent practices or for indulging in unfair trade practices as on last date of bidding for this tender.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Undertaking from the Company Secretary or the Authorized Signatory

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should have executed single order of Rs 5.5 crores / Two order of 2.75 crores each/ Three order of 1.84 crores each for supply of security solutions (SSL orchestrator / SSL Inspector / Web Application Firewall/ (SSL/TLS) Manager during last 7 years as on bid submission date to any SDC/State Govt. Department/GOI Department/Central or State PSU/ Enterprise.
The average annual turnover of the Bidder during last 3 financial years (2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25) shall not be less than Rs.11 Cr (Eleven Crores)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should have a positive net worth for the last 3 financial Years 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should not have filed for bankruptcy.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should have at least one permanent/working office in Bengaluru.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Self-Certificate issued by the HR head/Authorized signatory of the bidder organization.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: MAF to be submitted as per format given in the RFP

Supply of the SSL / TLS certificate of Domain Validation, Organization validation and Extended validation Certificate DV, OV, EV for 3 years
Supply of the SSL manager solution (appliance / licenses) for 3 years with warranty and support.
Supply of the SSL / TLS certificates as per the Bill of material sections 6 for the period of 3 years.
